dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I'll expedite it, but custom-made clothes normally take longer to make.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Should you leave before they're ready, I'll ship them to you via Komaniya Express.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: It's nothing. You gave me very precise measurements to work with. This shouldn't take too long.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Oh, and if you'd like, I can tailor dancing clothes for you as well.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Huh? I don't need any. I'm just buying this so I can practice with my lady. Normally I'd never get any use out of them.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Hmm... Is that so? Yet your eyes lingered on every single article of dancewear in my boutique.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: If I'm not wrong, you favor satin, with wave motifs and shorter hems, with ties on the wrists and sashes at the waist...

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: I merely followed your gaze and made a few simple observations. So, how's about it? If you'd like your own outfit, now's the perfect time to have one made.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Short on Mora?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: No, that's not it. I brought enough, but...

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Mmm... So you're hesitating for other reasons. Do you have any coins with you?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Huh? Yeah, I've got some, but...

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Flip one. Heads, buy. Tails, don't.

choices.text: Deciding things with a coin toss?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Yeah, that's way too random. I actually—

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Toss it. Now.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: The moment you do so, you'll know what your heart wants.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Dehya takes out a coin and flips it. It rotates in the air a few times, before she catches it on the back of her left hand, slamming her right over it.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: So. Heads or tails?

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: You needn't look. If right now, part of you is whispering, "Please be heads..."

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: It's time for you to buy yourself a new outfit.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Don't miss out on something you truly want because of some meaningless concerns you may have.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Hahaha! Alright, Boss. Make me some clothes.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Excellent. Step inside and you can tell me about your requirements — over some tea, of course.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, care to join us? We can take your measurements while we're at it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm good, thanks...

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Suit yourself. Just drop by during our normal operating hours when you'd like to place an order. I trust you know when those are by now.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Ahem. Ms. Dehya — this way, please.
